From tracking mysterious creatures to investigating strange sightings and unexplained phenomena, Phil Torres and Jessica Chobot have faced some of the most unusual cases. Whether they're following a creature through the wilderness or chasing answers to an unexplained mystery, their investigations rarely go as planned. Revisit some of Phil and Jess's most memorable adventures!
Watch Expedition X, S3, Episodes 2, 5, 3, 8, 9, 10 & 1 on Discovery Channel India.
